name: state_format_handles_brainstorm_put_back_retires
why: docs/state_format.md §6 / CR 400.7: Brainstorm's put-back is a hidden-to-hidden move with no look, so the caster's handles for the two cards retire as they leave the hand and nothing links them into the library; Ponder's look then issues fresh handles, and the opponent never holds one for either (step 1 T2 handles, --trace-handles)
expect_order: ^HANDLE: issue A h\d+ hand:A Force of Will$
^HANDLE: retire A h\d+ hand:A Force of Will \(zone change\)$
^Player A puts Force of Will to top of library
^HANDLE: retire A h\d+ hand:A Daze \(zone change\)$
^Player A puts Daze to top of library
^HANDLE: issue A h\d+ library:A@1 Force of Will$
